briefdescription.para: CANopen CiA 402 Device Profile for Drives and Motion Control.

detaileddescription.para: Implements a zero-heap, deterministic CiA 402 Drive Finite State Machine (Controlword 0x6040 / Statusword 0x6041), Motion Modes of Operation (PP, PV, PT, HM, CSP, CSV, CST), trapezoidal trajectory generation, following error supervision, and standard CANopen Object Dictionary binding.
